programmes.d: MacGyver helps a dissident Chinese student who is being pursued by Chinese government agents.
Five-O has 12 hours to find a test tube filled with the deadly Q strain, which science genius Alex Kline has hidden.
A high-voltage jewel thief in the guise of a socialite sets out to steal a treasured gem belonging to Hawaiian royalty.
Five-O is confronted with the problem of corralling foreign agents responsible for critically wounding a U.S. government undercover agent upon his return from a 10-year mission in Red China.

Contaminated heroin shatters a failing singer's desperate attempt at a comeback. Caught in the same quagmire of crime is the singer's drummer friend who dies from the toxic dope; Mike, who offers much needed help to McGarret.
McGarrett must thwart an elaborate assassination attempt on the life of a self-exiled Greek doctor.
After witnessing the grizzly destruction of a black rhino by poachers in Africa, MacGyver joins the fight to save the endangered species from extinction.
An investigation into art fraud leads MacGyver to expose a neo-Nazi group's plan to infiltrate American politics.
MacGyver and the kids at the Challenge Center discover the meaning of Christmas when they befriend a mysterious homeless woman.
MacGyver investigates a series of accidents befalling his childhood friend, Roxy Yeats, who fears her twin sister is behind the mishaps.
When everybody begins making demands on his time, an agitated and exhausted MacGyver escapes to the tranquil-sounding town of Serenity, Montana…and the year 1867.

A tender memory in McGarrett's past is suddenly shaken when his former fiancée, Cathy Wallis, finds her husband slain. McGarrett becomes personally involved in the case and jeopardizes his job when Cathy becomes the prime suspect.
The theft of a priceless violin belonging to a Russian musician touring in Honolulu threatens to explode into an international incident

The efforts of McGarrett's Five-O police unit to rescue a wealthy young boy from his ransom-hungry abductors backfire when McGarrett's own man, Kono, also becomes a prisoner of the thugs. Kono helps Timmy escape, but is unable to make a getaway himself.

The investigation of a boat explosion in which a wealthy businessman dies and McGarrett is seriously injured leads the Five-O team to believe that the widow's former husband is responsible for the sabotage.
A millionaire businessman is accused of being a former Japanese officer responsible for extreme physical and mental cruelty to U.S. World War II prisoners of war.
MacGyver volunteers to serve as a role model for a 16-year-old potential dropout and teach the boy the value of an education.
MacGyver goes undercover in a logging camp to investigate possible lumber smuggling by a ruthless Japanese businessman.
MacGyver heads down to Peru to investigate the death of an old friend's father, who was searching for legendary Incan treasure.
MacGyver sets up a sting operation to catch a criminal suspected of fixing horse races and laundering money for a Cuban drug lord.
MacGyver goes undercover to investigate the theft of a valuable sonar detecting device.
McGarrett leads an all-out search for the witness to a two-year-old murder in order to protect her from Harry Quon, one of Hawaii's most-wanted criminals and the crime's prime suspect.

McGarrett's unit searches for the conspirators who framed nightclub star Jimmy Nuanu, a crusader for ecological balance in Hawaii, to make him appear to be the saboteur of an inadequate sewage treatment plant.
Distinguished actor Hume Cronyn guest stars as Avery Filer, a master burglar of such brazen daring that he ignites a political inferno.
A strangler who writes the poetry of Byron in lipstick on the legs of two victims, one of them Danny's fiancée, must be stopped in time to prevent a third murder.

Steve McGarrett must apprehend a hoodlum and his girlfriend in order to save their lives. The two are being sought by two men from whom they stole a large cash ransom which they acquired by carrying out an abduction.
